e.body:
**claimdesk-analytics-mcp**（npm 包 `claimdesk-analytics-mcp`）**是一个**财险理赔分析 MCP 服务器****——**逐字自述为**「**MCP server for insurance claims analytics — portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports, and industry benchmark comparisons for P&C insurance operations.**」**。**本次实测**：**许可 **MIT****、**版本 **0.1.0****（**⭐ 且**仅此一版**）**、**创建与最后修改**同为 **2026-05-12**（**逐字** `2026-05-12T19:33:51Z` 与** `19:33:52Z`**）**、**依赖逐字为** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` **与** `zod`**、**维护者逐字为** `crawde`**；**⚠️ 而**元数据中**没有** `repository`**、**也没有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**包登记里的东西：调用一次才算数**」**。

**可核实信息（均 npm registry 元数据与包内 README 实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五个工具被逐字列出，**且每个都写了它回答什么****——**逐字为**：**① `analyze_claims_portfolio`**「**Loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy, and actionable insights**」**；**② `adjuster_scorecard`**「**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**」**；**③ `loss_development`**「**Chain-ladder loss development triangles, IBNR projections, ultimate loss ratios**」**；**④ `claims_trend_report`**「**Frequency/severity/loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts**」**；**⑤ `benchmark_analysis`**「**Compare your metrics against industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**」**。**⭐ 本词条认为**第 ③ 项最值得记**：**⭐ 即**链梯三角、**IBNR 与**终极赔付率**这三件事**正是**准备金工作的核心词汇**，**而**它们**在一个**通用的 MCP 服务器**里**出现**——**⭐ 这与本站第 355／356 轮覆盖的**准备金工具**（**[[verified-reserving]]、**[[loss-reserving-engine]]、**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]] 等**）**相比**，**差别在**交付形态**：**前者是库或脚本，**这一条是**给 Agent 调用的服务**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**理算员评分卡**」是本条最需要如实标注的一处**——**逐字为**「**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**」**，**即**对一个**具体的人**做**加权评分、**排名与同侪比较**，**并**给出**改进计划****。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得单独记**：**⭐ 即**同一个工具包里**既有**对物（**三角、**IBNR）的统计**，**也有**对人（**理算员）的评分**——**⭐ 而**后者**涉及**公平性、**申诉与治理**；**⭐ 本词条**如实指出**：**在**元数据里**看不到**评分权重、**数据来源、**复核机制或**申诉渠道**的任何说明**，**也不主张**该功能**是否被实际使用**。**⭐⭐ ③ 十二个业务条线被列出**——**逐字为** Auto、**Property、**General Liability、**Workers Comp、**Cyber、**Professional Liability、**Health、**Homeowners、**Commercial Property、**Marine、**Umbrella、**Product Liability**。**⭐ 本词条认为这一处值得记**：**⭐ 即**它**覆盖的条线**比**一家公司的实际经营范围**更宽**——**⭐ 而**一个**通用工具**声称**同时懂十二条线**时，**读者**应当先问**每一条线的口径从哪来**。**⭐⭐ ④ 基准分析点名了**四家来源，**而这四家的性质各不相同****——**逐字为**「**industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**」**：**⭐ 即**ISO **是**数据与标准机构**、**NAIC **是**州监管者协会**、**AM Best **是**评级机构**、**NCCI **是**工伤险的费率与统计机构**——**⭐ 本词条认为**把四者并列**是**可核的**（**各自口径不同**）**，**而**元数据里**没有给出**任何一份基准的**具体来源、**版本或**许可**——**⚠️ 故**本词条**只记录其自述**，**不主张**其基准**真实可核对**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 安装与配置被写明，**且**付费档位被标出**——**逐字给出** `npx claimdesk-analytics-mcp`**，**并给出 **Claude Desktop **的配置片段**；**环境变量逐字含** `CLAIMDESK_API_KEY`（**逐字标注为** Optional，**用于** premium analytics features**）**。**⭐ 本词条认为**「**可选密钥对应高级功能**」**这一设计值得记**：**⭐ 即**免费部分**与**付费部分**的边界**写在环境变量上**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 三处**须如实标注**：**① **与池内条目**同作者****——**本站 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的维护者/仓库同样出自 `crawde`**（**⭐ 本词条**据此明确声明**：**两者**是两个不同的包**，**本词条**未做任何代码级比较**）**；**② **没有仓库字段**，**故**本次无法核对实现**；**③ **只有 **0.1.0** 一个版本、**创建与修改**相隔 **1 秒****——**⭐ 即**这是一次**单次发布**，**没有后续维护痕迹**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、**[[claimpilot-harness]]、**[[digital-claims-management]] 覆盖理赔流程与分诊**，**[[loss-reserving-engine]]、**[[verified-reserving]]、**[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]]、**[[reserving-ml]]、**[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]] 覆盖准备金方法**，**[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、**[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]] 覆盖理赔风险分析**——**⭐ 而本条补上的是**「**把**组合分析、**理算员评分、**链梯与 IBNR、**趋势预测与**同业基准**打包成五个 Agent 工具**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**本条与 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[verified-reserving]] 应当并读**；**⭐ 而对本词条项目最有借鉴的四点**：**① **工具说明要写清「**它回答什么**」**（**本条五条都做到了**）**；**② **凡对**人**做评分的功能**，**要在文档里说明**权重、**数据与申诉**；**③ **引用同业基准时要给出**具体来源与版本**，**而不只是机构缩写**；**④ **免费与付费的边界**要写在**能被看到的地方**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装该包、**没有调用任何工具**（**未生成任何损失报告、**未计算任何赔付率或 IBNR、**未对任何理算员评分**），**故**不主张**其任何功能可用**、**也不主张**其任何计算结果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只读了 npm 元数据与包内 README**，**未读任何源码**（**⭐ 且元数据未给仓库地址，**故也难以找到源码**）**——**⚠️ 本条目最需后续核实的一处**。**③ ⚠️ 未核实**其**基准来源**（**ISO／**NAIC／**AM Best／**NCCI）**是否**真的被授权引用**，**也未核实**任何一份基准的**口径与版本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核实**其**链梯与 IBNR 实现**是否符合**通行方法**（**⭐ README 未提到任何文献或验证**）**——**⚠️ 而**这直接决定**其输出能否被引用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核实**理算员评分卡**的**权重、**数据来源与**公平性考量**；**⚠️ 本词条并如实提示**：**在**雇佣与绩效场景**使用自动评分**可能涉及**合规与伦理问题**，**须由使用者自行评估**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核实**维护者身份**（**⭐ 只知 npm 用户名**）**；**也未核实**其与池内 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的关系**（**⭐ 本词条**只指出**两者同出一个用户名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口状况**：**该包创建于 **2026-05-12**（**在解冻窗口之外**）**，**且**自那以后**未再更新**——**本次按惯例把这一处写在这里**：**本条的缺口是**「**把准备金与理赔分析打包成五个 Agent 工具、**并含**理算员评分卡**」这一形态此前池内没有对应物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目所记为 2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**该服务**不是**任何持牌精算意见**，**其输出**不得**直接用于准备金、**定价或人事决定**。

**claimdesk-analytics-mcp**（npm 包 `claimdesk-analytics-mcp`）**是一個**財險理賠分析 MCP 伺服器****——**逐字自述為**「**MCP server for insurance claims analytics — portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports, and industry benchmark comparisons for P&C insurance operations.**」**。**本次實測**：**許可 MIT**、**版本 0.1.0（**僅此一版**）**、**建立與最後修改**同為 **2026-05-12**、**依賴逐字為** `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 與 `zod`**、**維護者逐字為** `crawde`**；**⚠️ 而**元資料中**沒有** `repository`**、**也沒有** `homepage`****。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**包登記裡的東西：調用一次才算數**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 npm registry 元資料與包內 README 實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 五個工具逐字列出，**且每個都寫了它回答什麼****：`analyze_claims_portfolio`（**Loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy, and actionable insights**）、`adjuster_scorecard`（**Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**）、`loss_development`（**Chain-ladder loss development triangles, IBNR projections, ultimate loss ratios**）、`claims_trend_report`（**Frequency/severity/loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts**）、`benchmark_analysis`（**Compare your metrics against industry benchmarks (ISO, NAIC, AM Best, NCCI)**）**——**⭐ 第 ③ 項最值得記**：**鏈梯三角、**IBNR 與**終極賠付率**正是**準備金工作的核心詞彙**，**而**它們**出現在一個通用的 MCP 伺服器裡**。**⭐⭐⭐ ② 「**理算員評分卡**」是最需如實標註的一處**——**逐字** Weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison, improvement plans**——**⭐ 即**同一個工具包裡**既有**對物的統計**，**也有**對人的評分**；**⭐ 而**元資料裡**看不到**評分權重、**資料來源、**覆核機制或**申訴渠道**的任何說明**。**⭐⭐ ③ 十二個業務條線**：Auto、Property、General Liability、Workers Comp、Cyber、Professional Liability、Health、Homeowners、Commercial Property、Marine、Umbrella、Product Liability**——**⭐ 一個通用工具聲稱同時懂十二條線時**，**讀者應先問**每條線的口徑從哪來**。**⭐⭐ ④ 基準分析點名四家來源**（**ISO／**NAIC／**AM Best／**NCCI**）**——**⭐ 四者性質不同**（**數據與標準機構／**監管者協會／**評級機構／**工傷險費率統計機構**）**，**而**元資料**未給出**任何一份基準的**具體來源、**版本或**許可****。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 安裝與配置**：`npx claimdesk-analytics-mcp`**；**環境變數逐字含** `CLAIMDESK_API_KEY`（**逐字標註為** Optional，**用於** premium analytics features**）**——**⭐ 即**免費與付費的邊界**寫在環境變數上**。**⭐⭐ ⑥ ⚠️ 三處須如實標註**：**與池內 [[claims-triage-mcp]] **同維護者用户名**（**⭐ 兩者是不同的包，**本詞條未做任何代碼級比較**）**；**沒有倉庫欄位**；**只有 0.1.0 一版、**建立與修改相隔 1 秒**。**⭐⭐ ⑦ 與池內條目的關係**：[[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[claimpilot-harness]]、[[digital-claims-management]]、[[loss-reserving-engine]]、[[verified-reserving]]、[[hgr-hidden-grammar-reserving]]、[[reserving-ml]]、[[motor-loss-reserving-dl]]、[[claims-integrity-investigator]]、[[insurance-claims-risk-analytics]]——**⭐ 而本條補上的是**「**把組合分析、**理算員評分、**鏈梯與 IBNR、**趨勢預測與**同業基準打包成五個 Agent 工具**」這一形態**；**⭐ 本詞條**不對以上任何一條做代碼級比較****。

**對 RIAA**：**本條與 [[claims-triage-mcp]]、[[verified-reserving]] 應當並讀**；**⭐ 四點最值得借鑑**：**① **工具說明要寫清「**它回答什麼**」**；**② **對人做評分的功能**要說明**權重、**數據與**申訴**；**③ **引用同業基準要給出來源與版本**；**④ **免費與付費的邊界**要寫在看得見的地方**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝該包、**沒有調用任何工具**，**不主張**其任何功能可用**、**也不主張**其任何計算結果**。**② ⚠️⚠️ 本次**只讀了 npm 元資料與 README**，**未讀任何原始碼**（**且元資料未給倉庫位址**）——**⚠️ 本條目最需後續核實的一處**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**其**基準來源**是否**真的被授權引用****，**未核實**任何基準的口徑與版本**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其**鏈梯與 IBNR 實現**是否符合通行方法**（**README 未提任何文獻或驗證**）**——**⚠️ 這直接決定其輸出能否被引用**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**理算員評分卡的權重、**資料來源與公平性考量**；**⚠️ 在僱傭與績效場景使用自動評分**可能涉及**合規與倫理問題**，**須由使用者自行評估**。**⑥ ⚠️ 未核實**維護者身份**；**未核實**其與 [[claims-triage-mcp]] 的關係**（**只指出兩者同出一個用户名**）**。**⑦ ⚠️ **窗口狀況**：**該包建立於 2026-05-12（**窗口之外**）**，**其後未再更新**——**缺口是**「**把準備金與理賠分析打包成五個 Agent 工具、**並含理算員評分卡**」這一形態此前池內沒有對應物**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 該服務**不是**任何持牌精算意見**，**其輸出不得**直接用於準備金、**定價或人事決定**。

The npm package claimdesk-analytics-mcp **is a property and casualty claims analytics server for agents**, described verbatim as covering portfolio analysis, adjuster performance scorecards, loss development triangles, trend reports and industry benchmark comparisons for insurance operations. **Measured this round**: licensed MIT, at the single version 0.1.0, created and last modified one second apart on the same day in May, depending on the official protocol SDK and a schema validator, maintained by one registry user name, and **declaring neither a repository nor a homepage**. **This entry belongs to the round theme of what sits in a package registry, where only a call counts.**

**Verified information, all measured from the registry metadata and the package readme**: **first, five tools are listed verbatim with what each answers**: a portfolio tool returning loss ratios, severity, frequency, reserve adequacy and actionable insights; a scorecard tool returning weighted performance scoring, rankings, peer comparison and improvement plans; a loss development tool returning chain-ladder triangles, incurred-but-not-reported projections and ultimate loss ratios; a trend tool returning frequency, severity and loss ratio trends with forecasting and alerts; and a benchmark tool comparing metrics against four named industry sources. **The third of those is the one to note, because chain-ladder triangles, incurred-but-not-reported amounts and ultimate loss ratios are the core vocabulary of reserving, and here they appear inside a general-purpose agent server rather than in a library or a script.** **Second, the adjuster scorecard is the component this entry flags most strongly**: it is described verbatim as weighted performance scoring with rankings, peer comparison and improvement plans, meaning the same package that computes statistics about triangles also scores individual people. **The metadata shows no scoring weights, no data source, no review mechanism and no appeal channel, and this entry does not claim whether the feature is used in practice.** **Third, twelve lines of business are listed**, covering auto, property, general liability, workers compensation, cyber, professional liability, health, homeowners, commercial property, marine, umbrella and product liability. **A general tool claiming to understand twelve lines at once invites the question of where each line definitions come from.** **Fourth, the benchmark tool names four sources of very different kinds**, namely a data and standards body, a state regulator association, a rating agency and a workers compensation statistical organisation, all four appearing in one parenthesis with **no specific dataset, version or licence given anywhere in the metadata**, so this entry records the claim without asserting that the benchmarks are checkable. **Fifth, installation and configuration are written out**, with an install command, a desktop client configuration snippet, and an optional environment variable whose description states that it unlocks premium analytics features, **which is where the boundary between the free and paid parts is drawn**. **Sixth, three points must be stated plainly**: the package shares its registry user name with a pooled claims triage server, so **this entry states explicitly that they are two different packages and makes no code-level comparison**; there is no repository field, so the implementation could not be inspected; and there is exactly one version whose creation and modification timestamps are one second apart, meaning a single publication with no later maintenance. **Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover claims triage and claims process tooling, several reserving methods and tools, and claims risk analysis, **while this entry supplies a package that bundles portfolio analysis, adjuster scoring, chain-ladder and incurred-but-not-reported calculations, trend forecasting and industry benchmarks into five agent tools. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **this entry reads alongside the pooled claims triage server and the pooled verified reserving entry**; **four practices transfer directly: describe each tool by what it answers; when a feature scores people, document the weights, the data and the appeal route; give a specific source and version when citing industry benchmarks rather than an acronym; and put the boundary between free and paid where it can be seen**.

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed and no tool was called** — no loss report generated, no loss ratio or incurred-but-not-reported amount computed and no adjuster scored — **so no claim is made about whether any feature works or about any computed result**. **Second, only the registry metadata and the readme were read, and no source code was read**, the metadata giving no repository address in any case, **which is the item most in need of later verification**. **Third, whether the four benchmark sources are actually licensed for use was not verified, nor were the definitions or versions of any benchmark. Fourth, whether the chain-ladder and incurred-but-not-reported implementations follow standard methods was not verified**, the readme citing no literature or validation, **which directly determines whether its output can be cited**. **Fifth, the weights, data sources and fairness considerations of the adjuster scorecard were not verified; this entry notes plainly that automated scoring in employment or performance settings may raise compliance and ethical questions that the user must assess.** **Sixth, the maintainer identity was not verified**, only a registry user name being visible, nor was the relationship to the pooled claims triage server established, **this entry recording only that the two share a user name**. **Seventh, on the window: the package was created in May, outside the thaw window, and has not been updated since**, and following the project convention of naming the gap, **the gap here is that bundling reserving and claims analytics into five agent tools, including an adjuster scorecard, had no counterpart in the pool. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11, and states plainly that the service is not a licensed actuarial opinion and that its output must not be used directly for reserving, pricing or personnel decisions.**
